title: Dṛg-dṛśya-viveka
subtitle: A 46-verse inquiry into the seer and the seen · traditionally attributed to Bhāratī Tīrtha; authorship remains debated

source.note: Sanskrit witness: Swami Nikhilananda, Drg Drsya Viveka (Sri Ramakrishna Asrama, 1931). The English translation and word-level gloss are newly prepared for this reader.

translationCredit: Original English translation and word-level gloss prepared for Viveka Dṛṣṭi.

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
रूपं दृश्यं लोचनं दृक् तद् दृश्यं दृक् तु मानसम्।
दृश्या धीवृत्तयः साक्षी दृगेव न तु दृश्यते॥
units.translation: Forms are seen; the eye is their seer. The eye in turn is seen; the mind is its seer. The mind’s thoughts are seen; the Witness alone is their seer, and is never itself seen.

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
नीलपीतस्थूलसूक्ष्मह्रस्वदीर्घादिभेदतः।
नानाविधानि रूपाणि पश्येल्लोचनमेकधा॥
units.translation: Though one, the eye sees forms of many kinds, differing as blue or yellow, gross or subtle, short or long, and so forth.

gloss.en: through differences such as blue/yellow, gross/subtle, short/long

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
आन्ध्यमान्द्यपटुत्वेषु नेत्रधर्मेषु चैकधा।
सङ्कल्पयेन्मनः श्रोत्रत्वगादौ योज्यतामिदम्॥
units.translation: The one mind recognizes blindness, dullness, and acuity as conditions of the eye. Apply this same inquiry to the ear, skin, and the other senses.

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
कामः सङ्कल्पसन्देहौ श्रद्धाश्रद्धे धृतीतरे।
ह्रीर्धीर्भीरित्येवमादीन् भासयत्येकधा चितिः॥
units.translation: Consciousness, one and the same, illumines desire, resolve and doubt, faith and its absence, steadiness and its opposite, shame, understanding, fear, and the rest.

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
नोदेति नास्तमेत्येषा न वृद्धिं याति न क्षयम्।
स्वयं विभात्यथान्यानि भासयेत्साधनं विना॥
units.translation: This awareness neither rises nor sets; it neither increases nor diminishes. It shines by itself and, without another instrument, illumines all other things.

units.label: Verse 6
units.deva:
चिच्छायावेशतो बुद्धौ भानं धीस्तु द्विधा स्थिता।
एकाहङ्कृतिरन्या स्यादन्तःकरणरूपिणी॥
units.translation: Because consciousness is reflected in the intellect, knowing appears there. The intellect has two aspects: one is the ego-sense, and the other is the inner instrument of thought.

gloss.en: through the presence of consciousness’s reflection
has the form of the inner instrument

units.label: Verse 7
units.deva:
छायाहङ्कारयोरैक्यं तप्तायःपिण्डवन्मतम्।
तदहङ्कारतादात्म्याद्देहश्चेतनतामगात्॥
units.translation: The reflection of consciousness and the ego are regarded as united, like a red-hot iron ball. Through identification with that ego, the body appears to acquire sentience.

gloss.en: of the reflection and the ego

units.label: Verse 8
units.deva:
अहङ्कारस्य तादात्म्यं चिच्छायादेहसाक्षिभिः।
सहजं कर्मजं भ्रान्तिजन्यञ्च त्रिविधं क्रमात्॥
units.translation: The ego’s identification with reflected consciousness, the body, and the Witness is threefold: innate, produced by karma, and born of delusion, respectively.

gloss.en: with reflected consciousness, the body, and the Witness

units.label: Verse 9
units.deva:
सम्बन्धिनोः सतोर्नास्ति निवृत्तिः सहजात्तु।
कर्मक्षयात्प्रबोधाच्च निवर्तेते क्रमादुभे॥
units.translation: While the reflection and ego remain connected, their innate identification does not cease. The other two cease in sequence: one through the exhaustion of karma, the other through awakening.

units.label: Verse 10
units.deva:
अहङ्कारलये सुप्तौ भवेद्देहोऽप्यचेतनः।
अहङ्कारविकासार्धः स्वप्नः सर्वस्तु जागरः॥
units.translation: When the ego subsides in deep sleep, the body too is insentient. The partial manifestation of the ego is dream; its full manifestation is waking.

gloss.en: the partial unfolding of the ego

units.label: Verse 11
units.deva:
अन्तःकरणवृत्तिश्च चितिच्छायैक्यमागता।
वासनाः कल्पयेत्स्वप्ने बोधेऽक्षैर्विषयान्बहिः॥
units.translation: The mind’s thought, joined with the reflection of consciousness, projects latent impressions in dream; in waking it presents external objects through the senses.

gloss.en: joined with the reflection of consciousness

units.label: Verse 12
units.deva:
मनोऽहङ्कृत्युपादानं लिङ्गमेकं जडात्मकम्।
अवस्थात्रयमन्वेति जायते म्रियते तथा॥
units.translation: The subtle body, basis of mind and ego, is one insentient entity. It passes through the three states and is spoken of as being born and dying.

gloss.en: the basis of mind and ego

units.label: Verse 13
units.deva:
शक्तिद्वयं हि मायाया विक्षेपावृतिरूपकम्।
विक्षेपशक्तिर्लिङ्गादिब्रह्माण्डान्तं जगत्सृजेत्॥
units.translation: Māyā has two powers, projection and concealment. The power of projection creates the world, from the subtle body up to the cosmic egg.

gloss.en: taking the forms of projection and concealment

units.label: Verse 14
units.deva:
सृष्टिर्नाम ब्रह्मरूपे सच्चिदानन्दवस्तुनि।
अब्धौ फेनादिवत्सर्वनामरूपप्रसारणा॥
units.translation: “Creation” is the spreading out of all names and forms upon reality, whose nature is Being, Consciousness, and Bliss—like foam and the like upon the ocean.

gloss.en: reality as Being, Consciousness, and Bliss
the spreading out of all names and forms

units.label: Verse 15
units.deva:
अन्तर्दृग्दृश्ययोर्भेदं बहिश्च ब्रह्मसर्गयोः।
आवृणोत्यपरा शक्तिः सा संसारस्य कारणम्॥
units.translation: Another power conceals within the distinction between seer and seen, and outwardly the distinction between Brahman and creation. That is the cause of worldly bondage.

gloss.en: the distinction between seer and seen

units.label: Verse 16
units.deva:
साक्षिणः पुरतो भातं लिङ्गं देहेन संयुतम्।
चिच्छायासमावेशाज्जीवः स्याद्व्यावहारिकः॥
units.translation: The subtle body, joined to the physical body and appearing before the Witness through the presence of reflected consciousness, is the empirical individual self.

gloss.en: through the presence of reflected consciousness

units.label: Verse 17
units.deva:
अस्य जीवत्वमारोपात्साक्षिण्यप्यवभासते।
आवृतौ तु विनष्टायां भेदे भातेऽपयाति तत्॥
units.translation: By superimposition, this individual’s condition as a jīva seems to belong even to the Witness. When concealment is destroyed and the distinction is clear, that appearance disappears.

units.label: Verse 18
units.deva:
तथा सर्गब्रह्मणोश्च भेदमावृत्य तिष्ठति।
या शक्तिस्तद्वशाद्ब्रह्म विकृतत्वेन भासते॥
units.translation: Likewise, the power that conceals the difference between creation and Brahman remains in place; under its influence Brahman appears to have undergone change.

gloss.en: the distinction between creation and Brahman

units.label: Verse 19
units.deva:
अत्राप्यावृतिनाशेन विभाति ब्रह्मसर्गयोः।
भेदस्तयोर्विकारः स्यात्सर्गे न ब्रह्मणि क्वचित्॥
units.translation: Here too, when concealment is removed, the distinction between Brahman and creation becomes clear. Change belongs to creation; it never belongs to Brahman.

gloss.en: the distinction between Brahman and creation

units.label: Verse 20
units.deva:
अस्ति भाति प्रियं रूपं नाम चेत्यंशपञ्चकम्।
आद्यत्रयं ब्रह्मरूपं जगद्रूपं ततो द्वयम्॥
units.translation: Every appearance has five aspects: existence, shining, being dear, form, and name. The first three are Brahman’s nature; the other two belong to the world.

units.label: Verse 21
units.deva:
खवाय्वग्निजलोर्वीषु देवतिर्यङ्नरादिषु।
अभिन्नाः सच्चिदानन्दा भिद्येते रूपनामनी॥
units.translation: In space, air, fire, water, and earth, and among gods, animals, humans, and the rest, Being, Consciousness, and Bliss are undivided; name and form differ.

gloss.en: in space, air, fire, water, and earth
among gods, animals, humans, and others

units.label: Verse 22
units.deva:
उपेक्ष्य नामरूपे द्वे सच्चिदानन्दतत्परः।
समाधिं सर्वदा कुर्याद्धृदये वाथवा बहिः॥
units.translation: Setting aside name and form, one intent on Being, Consciousness, and Bliss should continually practice contemplation, whether within the heart or outwardly.

gloss.en: intent on Being, Consciousness, and Bliss

units.label: Verse 23
units.deva:
सविकल्पो निर्विकल्पः समाधिर्द्विविधो हृदि।
दृश्यशब्दानुविद्धेन सविकल्पः पुनर्द्विधा॥
units.translation: Contemplation in the heart is twofold: with conceptual distinctions and without them. The conceptual form is again of two kinds, associated with the seen or with words.

gloss.en: associated with the seen or with words

units.label: Verse 24
units.deva:
कामाद्याश्चित्तगादृश्यास्तत्साक्षित्वेन चेतनम्।
ध्यायेद्दृश्यानुविद्धोऽयं समाधिः सविकल्पकः॥
units.translation: Desire and the other states arising in the mind are seen; awareness is their witness. To meditate on this is conceptual contemplation associated with the seen.

units.label: Verse 25
units.deva:
असङ्गः सच्चिदानन्दः स्वप्रभो द्वैतवर्जितः।
अस्मीति शब्दविद्धोऽयं समाधिः सविकल्पकः॥
units.translation: “I am unattached, Being-Consciousness-Bliss, self-luminous, and free from duality”: contemplation shaped by these words is conceptual contemplation associated with verbal teaching.

units.label: Verse 26
units.deva:
स्वानुभूतिरसावेशाद्दृश्यशब्दानुपेक्षितुः।
निर्विकल्पः समाधिः स्यान्निवातस्थितदीपवत्॥
units.translation: For one absorbed in the savor of direct experience, with seen objects and words set aside, contemplation is free of conceptual thought, like a lamp in a windless place.

gloss.en: through immersion in the savor of direct experience
for one who has set aside
like a lamp placed where there is no wind

units.label: Verse 27
units.deva:
हृदीव बाह्यदेशेऽपि यस्मिन्कस्मिंश्च वस्तुनि।
समाधिराद्यः सन्मात्रान्नामरूपपृथक्कृतिः॥
units.translation: Whether in the heart or in any external object, the first contemplation consists in discerning pure existence apart from name and form.

units.label: Verse 28
units.deva:
अखण्डैकरसं वस्तु सच्चिदानन्दलक्षणम्।
इत्यविच्छिन्नचिन्तेयं समाधिर्मध्यमो भवेत्॥
units.translation: “Reality is undivided and of one essence, characterized as Being, Consciousness, and Bliss”: sustained contemplation of this is the middle form of samādhi.

gloss.en: characterized by Being, Consciousness, and Bliss

units.label: Verse 29
units.deva:
स्तब्धीभावो रसास्वादात्तृतीयः पूर्ववन्मतः।
एतैः समाधिभिः षड्भिर्नयेत्कालं निरन्तरम्॥
units.translation: The stillness that comes from savoring that fullness is regarded as the third form, as before. One should spend one’s time continually in these six contemplations.

gloss.en: by these six forms of contemplation

units.label: Verse 30
units.deva:
देहाभिमाने गलिते विज्ञाते परमात्मनि।
यत्र यत्र मनो याति तत्र तत्र समाधयः॥
units.translation: When identification with the body has fallen away and the supreme Self is known, wherever the mind goes, there is contemplation.

units.label: Verse 31
units.deva:
भिद्यते हृदयग्रन्थिश्छिद्यन्ते सर्वसंशयाः।
क्षीयन्ते चास्य कर्माणि तस्मिन्दृष्टे परावरे॥
units.translation: When the higher and lower are seen, the knot of the heart is broken, all doubts are cut, and that person’s actions are exhausted.

units.label: Verse 32
units.deva:
अवच्छिन्नश्चिदाभासस्तृतीयः स्वप्नकल्पितः।
विज्ञेयस्त्रिविधो जीवस्तत्राद्यः पारमार्थिकः॥
units.translation: The individual self is to be understood as threefold: the delimited self, reflected consciousness, and a third imagined in dream. Of these, the first is ultimate.

gloss.en: is to be understood as threefold

units.label: Verse 33
units.deva:
अवच्छेदः कल्पितः स्यादवच्छेद्यं तु वास्तवम्।
तस्मिञ्जीवत्वमारोपाद्ब्रह्मत्वं तु स्वभावतः॥
units.translation: Limitation is imagined, while that which is delimited is real. Individuality is superimposed upon it; Brahmanhood, however, is its very nature.

units.label: Verse 34
units.deva:
अवच्छिन्नस्य जीवस्य पूर्णेन ब्रह्मणैकताम्।
तत्त्वमस्यादिवाक्यानि जगुर्नेतरजीवयोः॥
units.translation: The great sayings beginning “That thou art” teach the identity of the delimited individual with the complete Brahman, not with the other two forms of jīva.

gloss.en: not of the other two jīvas

units.label: Verse 35
units.deva:
ब्रह्मण्यवस्थिता माया विक्षेपावरणात्मिका।
आवृत्याखण्डतां तस्मिञ्जगज्जीवौ प्रकल्पयेत्॥
units.translation: Māyā, resting in Brahman, has the powers of projection and concealment. By veiling Brahman’s indivisibility, it projects the world and the individual.

gloss.en: having the nature of projection and concealment

units.label: Verse 36
units.deva:
जीवो धीस्थश्चिदाभासो भवेद्भोक्ता हि कर्मकृत्।
भोग्यरूपमिदं सर्वं जगत्स्याद्भूतभौतिकम्॥
units.translation: The individual is reflected consciousness located in the intellect, an experiencer and performer of action. All this world, made of elements and their products, has the form of what is experienced.

gloss.en: made of elements and their products
is of the nature of what is experienced

units.label: Verse 37
units.deva:
अनादिकालमारभ्य मोक्षात्पूर्वमिदं द्वयम्।
व्यवहारे स्थितं तस्मादुभयं व्यावहारिकम्॥
units.translation: From beginningless time until liberation, this pair—the individual and the world—persists in everyday experience; therefore both are empirical.

units.label: Verse 38
units.deva:
चिदाभासस्थिता निद्रा विक्षेपावरणात्मिका।
आवृत्य जीवजगती पूर्वे नूत्ने तु कल्पयेत्॥
units.translation: Ignorance, lodged in reflected consciousness, has the powers of projection and concealment. Concealing the former individual and world, it projects new ones in dream.

gloss.en: having the nature of projection and concealment

units.label: Verse 39
units.deva:
प्रतीतिकाल एवैते स्थितत्वात्प्रातिभासिके।
न हि स्वप्नप्रबुद्धस्य पुनःस्वप्ने स्थितिस्तयोः॥
units.translation: Because these two exist only for the duration of their appearance, they are merely apparent. For one awakened from a dream, those two do not persist in a later dream.

gloss.en: only during the time of appearance
for one awakened from a dream

units.label: Verse 40
units.deva:
प्रातिभासिकजीवो यस्तज्जगत्प्रातिभासिकम्।
वास्तवं मन्यतेऽन्यस्तु मिथ्येति व्यावहारिकः॥
units.translation: The apparent individual regards the corresponding apparent world as real; the empirical individual, by contrast, regards it as false.

units.label: Verse 41
units.deva:
व्यावहारिकजीवो यस्तज्जगद्व्यावहारिकम्।
सत्यं प्रत्येति मिथ्येति मन्यते पारमार्थिकः॥
units.translation: The empirical individual regards the corresponding empirical world as real; the ultimate individual regards it as false.

units.label: Verse 42
units.deva:
पारमार्थिकजीवस्तु ब्रह्मैक्यं पारमार्थिकम्।
प्रत्येति वीक्षते नान्यद्वीक्षते त्वनृतात्मना॥
units.translation: The ultimate individual knows identity with Brahman as ultimate reality. Seeing that, one sees nothing else as a separate, independently real thing.

gloss.en: as having a separate, unreal nature

units.label: Verse 43
units.deva:
माधुर्यद्रवशैत्यानि नीरधर्मास्तरङ्गके।
अनुगम्याथ तन्निष्ठे फेणेऽप्यनुगता यथा॥
units.translation: Sweetness, liquidity, and coolness are qualities of water present in a wave; following that basis, they are found also in foam resting upon it.

units.label: Verse 44
units.deva:
साक्षिस्थाः सच्चिदानन्दाः सम्बन्धाद्व्यावहारिके।
तद्द्वारेणानुगच्छन्ति तथैव प्रातिभासिके॥
units.translation: Being, Consciousness, and Bliss belong to the Witness. Through their relation to the empirical individual, they extend in the same way to the apparent individual.

units.label: Verse 45
units.deva:
लये फेनस्य तद्धर्मा द्रवाद्याः स्युस्तरङ्गके।
तस्यापि विलये नीरे तिष्ठन्त्येते यथा पुरा॥
units.translation: When foam dissolves, its qualities such as liquidity are found in the wave; when the wave too dissolves into water, those qualities remain there as before.

units.label: Verse 46
units.deva:
प्रातिभासिकजीवस्य लये स्युर्व्यावहारिके।
तल्लये सच्चिदानन्दाः पर्यवस्यन्ति साक्षिणि॥
units.translation: When the apparent individual dissolves, Being, Consciousness, and Bliss are found in the empirical individual. When that one dissolves, they resolve in the Witness.
